verdict.rationale: Ollama ships a desktop chat app and agent integrations, so an AI document workspace is a plausible axis for it. However, no evidence shows an integrated workspace where an agent drafts and edits documents with automatic saving. The cited material covers model serving, APIs, coding-agent launch commands and chat, none of which is a document-editing workspace.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an AI agent draft and edit documents in an integrated workspace with changes saved automatically
